specs.prompt: Create ONE premium Maliu-embroidery-inspired folk motif for a coordinated Chinese textile website collection. Square canvas, genuine transparent background. Single compact balanced whole composition centered with 10% clear margins on all sides, visible entire silhouette. Exact unified palette: muted sage #648d76, deep jade #366750, coral #ee947e, pale apricot #efd1a3, warm ivory #faf4e7, minute matte ochre accents. Flat embroidered textile illustration with delicate dense diagonal satin stitches, stepped counted-thread geometric markings, crisp graceful silhouettes, soft matte surface, very shallow relief, minimal gradients. Match an existing set of jade and coral stitched butterflies and four-petal geometric medallions. Readable at thumbnail size, restrained fine detail, refined Chinese folk ornamental geometry. Not a photograph, no glossy 3D. No fabric rectangle, frame, hoop, words, label, watermark, shadow, background, or border. A contemporary creative interpretation, not a claimed reproduction of historical objects. SUBJECT: a single beautiful stylized magpie in profile facing left, slender beak holding a small jade twig with two leaves and a tiny coral blossom. Sage green and ivory wings embellished with coral and apricot stepped diamonds. Gracefully raised long tail curving to the right, coral breast, two delicate legs resting on a short flowering branch beneath. Elegant flowing compact bird-and-sprig composition. Recognizably a bird, no butterflies, no separate medallion.
